Axiom:
Compliance is checked against the union of rules listed across all phases of the Round (per each phase block's ` rules ` line — or equivalently the `Rules:` bullet list in section 3 Phases). Not the full cascade — only what phases actually loaded.
**Audit is universal — no embedded knowledge of any language, runtime, or tool.** Every rule file exposes the same checkable surface; audit walks these sections mechanically: - embedded `` → rule identities this rule architecturally extends (optional; empty for standalone rules). RuleResolver freezes the closure before dispatch — NOT walked by the phase agent. - `` → `` constraints - `` → `` shapes that must not appear - `` → executable check commands - `` → ✅ invariants / ❌ forbidden states
Required sections: `` / `` / `` / ``. Optional: `` (only when the rule extends another). Required section missing → `RULE_FILE_INCOMPLETE` (`MAJOR`); audit proceeds with available sections.
**Per (artifact ∈ Round diff, rule ∈ union of all phases' Rules):** 1. Use the frozen RuleSnapshot explanation to decide whether the rule governs this artifact. No selected rule/artifact match → skip pair. 2. Walk Reward_Criteria, Anti_Patterns, Verification_Hooks, then residual axioms (those not covered by the prior three). Each violation → `RULES_COMPLIANCE_VIOLATION` citing the specific ID (`AX_*` / `AP_*` / `HOOK_*` / Reward_Criteria line verbatim) + `Location: :`. 3. Decision Log overrides take precedence — adapted / overridden axiom → suppress finding, record `Override-honored: -DL-N`.
**Improper-skip.** Diff has artifact of a category while Execution Log shows `skip` for that category → `RULES_COMPLIANCE_VIOLATION` tagged `improper-skip` (`MAJOR`).
**No invented criteria.** Suspicion without a backing rule line → `INSIGHT_BACKFLOW` (proposal to add a rule), not a finding.
